summary: Preserve conditional idle repository polling with inclusive timestamp boundaries, resumable overlap pagination and bounded admission endpoint/status attribution.

replay.detail: No graph replay or stored-state backfill. Older observer cursors default optional overlap maps and continuation URLs and safely replay their first overlap.

schema.detail: Storage version unchanged. No database migration. Optional cursor fields and defaulted local admission endpoint/response classes preserve old records and reservations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or coordinated upgrade requirement. Shared-token admission remains local to each daemon.

compatibility.detail: Repository item and comment requests overlap the stored watermark by one second, deduplicate by identity/update time and preserve exact pagination continuations. Idle URLs remain stable for ETag revalidation. Doctor adds bounded endpoint/status counts, distinguishing 304 hits from possible quota-bearing requests; 304s still consume conservative local admission reservations. This change does not alter watch cadence or stopped-seat watch lifecycle.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime or special rollout sequence. No live daemon is changed by this source patch.

manual.detail: No configuration change, migration or backfill required. Fleet owner election and rate-limit-header backoff remain design-only options in docs/st3/github-observer-admission.md.

recovery.detail: Rollback requires no storage migration. Older readers ignore optional cursor and admission attribution fields; reservations remain intact.
